summary: H11 is rejected and cannot be a Golden reference. It passes every unchanged H4 automated raster proxy, including all B1 palette and 50%/25% readability thresholds, but automated exact-block hashing cannot detect semantic motif reuse. Root Vision review finds massive repeated triangular, conical, arrowhead-like, and rounded vegetation or terrain symbols across the map. That immediate failure alone disqualifies H11; its score is deliberately limited to 68/100, below the required 94.
required_changes: Keep H11's successful B1-family colour calibration while replacing the entire repeated triangular, conical, arrowhead-like, and rounded-glyph field.
Use connected irregular canopy masses, varied clearings, non-convergent flat hachure, stipple, and natural gaps with no visible stamp cadence.
Re-run the unchanged automated gates and a fresh full Vision review; automated proxy success alone must never be treated as Golden acceptance.
